questions.question: If (x+y):(x-y)=5:2, find x 3 + y 3 : x 3 - y 3
questions.questionHtml: If (x+y):(x-y)=5:2, find x3 + y3  : x3 - y3
questions.solution:
Let x + y = 5k and x − y = 2k

⇒ Adding: 2x = 7k ⇒ x = 7k ÷ 2

⇒ Subtracting: 2y = 3k ⇒ y = 3k ÷ 2

x3 + y3 = (7k ÷ 2)3 + (3k ÷ 2)3 = 343k3 ÷ 8 + 27k3 ÷ 8 = 370k3 ÷ 8

x3 − y3 = (7k ÷ 2)3 − (3k ÷ 2)3 = 343k3 ÷ 8 − 27k3 ÷ 8 = 316k3 ÷ 8

Ratio = 370k3 ÷ 8 : 316k3 ÷ 8 = 370 : 316 = 185 : 158

questions.question: A trader marked an article 40% above its cost price. He then allowed a discount of 20% on the marked price. If the selling price of the article was ₹560, what was its cost price?
questions.questionHtml: A trader marked an article 40% above its cost price. He then allowed a discount of 20% on the marked price. If the selling price of the article was ₹560, what was its cost price?
questions.solution:
Let Cost Price = x

Marked Price = x × 1.4

Selling Price = 1.4x × 0.8 = 1.12x

1.12x = 560 ⇒ x = 560 ÷ 1.12 ⇒ x = 500

questions.question: A sum becomes 2.5 times of itself in 5 years under simple interest. In how many years will it become 5 times itself at the same rate?
questions.questionHtml: A sum becomes 2.5 times of itself in 5 years under simple interest. In how many years will it become 5 times itself at the same rate?
questions.solution:
<svg width="450" height="260" viewBox="0 0 450 260" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" style="display:block;margin:1px;padding:0;background:#ffffff;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #cccccc;box-sizing:border-box;">

    <marker id="arrG" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="6" markerHeight="6" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#007700"/></marker>

  <text x="60" y="105" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#555555">t = 0</text>

  <text x="380" y="90" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial" font-size="14" fill="#cc5500" font-weight="700">5P</text>

questions.question: A ladder reaches a window 8 meters high on a vertical wall. If the ladder is positioned at a 45° angle to the ground, what is its length? (nearest to a whole number)
questions.questionHtml: A ladder reaches a window 8 meters high on a vertical wall. If the ladder is positioned at a 45° angle to the ground, what is its length? (nearest to a whole number)
questions.solution:
sin45º = 8 ÷ Length

⇒ 1 ÷ √2 = 8 ÷ Length

⇒ Length = 8 × √2 ≈ 8 × 1.414 ≈ 11.31

questions.question: A solid cylinder has a radius of 5 cm and a height of 10 cm. A smaller cylindrical hole of radius 3 cm is drilled coaxially through its entire length. What is the approximate volume of the remaining solid?
questions.questionHtml: A solid cylinder has a radius of 5 cm and a height of 10 cm. A smaller cylindrical hole of radius 3 cm is drilled coaxially through its entire length. What is the approximate volume of the remaining solid?
questions.solution:
Volume of big cylinder = π × 52 × 10 ⇒ 250π

Volume of hole = π × 32 × 10 ⇒ 90π

Remaining volume = 250π − 90π ⇒ 160π ≈ 502 cm3

questions.question: A right circular cone having height of 30 cm is cut by two parallel planes at heights 10 cm and 20 cm from the base. What is the ratio of the volumes of the three parts (from top to bottom)?
questions.questionHtml: A right circular cone having height of 30 cm is cut by two parallel planes at heights 10 cm and 20 cm from the base. What is the ratio of the volumes of the three parts (from top to bottom)?
questions.solution:
Total height = 30, planes at heights = 10 and 20.

Height of top cone = 30 − 20 = 10, height up to second plane = 30 − 10 = 20.

Volume ratio (top cone) = 103 = 1000, up to second plane = 203 = 8000, whole cone = 303 = 27000.

Middle part = 8000 − 1000 = 7000, bottom part = 27000 − 8000 = 19000.

Ratio = 1000 : 7000 : 19000 = 1 : 7 : 19.

questions.question: A solid hemisphere of radius R is melted and recast into n smaller hemispheres of radius r. Find the value of n.
questions.questionHtml: A solid hemisphere of radius R is melted and recast into n smaller hemispheres of radius r. Find the value of n.
questions.solution:
Volume of large hemisphere = (2 ÷ 3) × π × R3

Volume of one small hemisphere = (2 ÷ 3) × π × r3

n × (2 ÷ 3) × π × r3 = (2 ÷ 3) × π × R3

n × r3 = R3

n = (R ÷ r)3

questions.question: If sin x + cos x = √2, what is the value of sin x - cos x?
questions.questionHtml: If sin x + cos x = √2, what is the value of sin x - cos x?
questions.solution:
(sinx + cosx)2 = sin2x + cos2x + 2sinxcosx

⇒ (√2)2 = 1 + 2sinxcosx

⇒ 2sinxcosx = 1

(sinx − cosx)2 = sin2x + cos2x − 2sinxcosx

⇒ 1 − 1 = 0

⇒ sinx − cosx = 0

questions.question: A sector has a central angle of 90° and a radius of 6 cm. Another sector has a central angle of π/2radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second sector?
questions.questionHtml: A sector has a central angle of 90° and a radius of 6 cm. Another sector has a central angle of π/2radians. What is the ratio of the area of the first sector to the area of the second sector?
questions.solution:
Area1 = (90 ÷ 360) × π × 62 ⇒ Area1 = (1 ÷ 4) × π × 36 ⇒ Area1 = 9π

Area2 = (1 ÷ 2) × 62 × (π ÷ 2) ⇒ Area2 = (1 ÷ 2) × 36 × (π ÷ 2) ⇒ Area2 = 9π

Ratio = 9π : 9π ⇒ Ratio = 1 : 1

questions.question: A point P is 13 cm away from the center of a circle. A tangent is drawn from P to the circle, and its length is 12 cm. What is the area of the circle?
questions.questionHtml: A point P is 13 cm away from the center of a circle. A tangent is drawn from P to the circle, and its length is 12 cm. What is the area of the circle?
questions.solution:
Let distance from center to external point = 13 cm, tangent length = 12 cm.

⇒ 132 = r2 + 122

⇒ 169 = r2 + 144

⇒ r2 = 169 − 144 = 25

⇒ Area = π × 25 = 25π cm2

questions.questionHtml: In △ABC, an angle bisector from A meets BC at D. If AD bisects ∠BAC, and AB=AC, are △ABD and △ACD congruent? If so, by what rule?

⇒ ∠BAD = ∠CAD

questions.question: The angle between two tangents drawn from an external point to a circle is 60°. What is the angle subtended by the chord connecting their points of contact at the center?
questions.questionHtml: The angle between two tangents drawn from an external point to a circle is 60°. What is the angle subtended by the chord connecting their points of contact at the center?
questions.solution:
Angle between two tangents = 180º − angle subtended by chord at center

⇒ 60 = 180 − Central angle

⇒ Central angle = 180 − 60 = 120º

questions.question: From a point P outside a circle, a tangent PA and a secant PBC are drawn. If PA=6 cm and BC=5 cm, what is the length of the segment PB?
questions.questionHtml: From a point P outside a circle, a tangent PA and a secant PBC are drawn. If PA=6 cm and BC=5 cm, what is the length of the segment PB?
questions.solution:
Let PA = 6 cm, BC = 5 cm.

PA2 = PB × PC ⇒ 62 = PB × (PB + 5).

36 = PB2 + 5PB ⇒ PB2 + 5PB − 36 = 0.

(PB − 4)(PB + 9) = 0 ⇒ PB = 4 cm.
